01 Parties and Purpose

This Statement of Work (“SoW”) is entered into between the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (“IIIT-H”) and DHAROHAR CHARITABLE FOUNDATION (“Dharohar”).

IIIT-H will provide Dharohar access to its existing LekhyaAI manuscript line-segmentation service through an IIIT-H-hosted API. For each manuscript folio submitted, the service returns detected manuscript text lines as polygon coordinates together with associated structured output.

Scope boundary. This SoW covers access to the IIIT-H-hosted LekhyaAI line-segmentation API.

02 Nature and Scope of Service

LekhyaAI line segmentation is an existing IIIT-H technology provided on an as-is basis.

IIIT-H will:

  • host and operate the API;
  • provide API credentials and interface documentation;
  • provide reasonable assistance for API integration and operation; and
  • operate the API using the production version of LekhyaAI maintained by IIIT-H from time to time.

Dharohar will:

  • integrate the API into its manuscript-processing workflow;
  • maintain the confidentiality of API credentials;
  • submit only manuscript material permitted to be processed through the hosted service; and
  • use the service for its institutional manuscript-related activities unless otherwise agreed.

No specific segmentation accuracy, collection-specific model development, custom training, or new functionality is guaranteed under this SoW unless separately agreed.

03 Billing Unit

One manuscript folio = one billable page. Where a source image contains multiple physical manuscript folios, each folio is counted separately.

Standard pricing assumes a typical manuscript folio contains approximately 10 text lines. Moderate variations in line count will not result in fractional or additional billing.

Exceptionally dense, composite, unusually large, or otherwise atypical inputs that materially increase processing requirements may be discussed separately before processing.

04 API Pricing and Committed-Volume Pricing

Standard on-demand pricing. For usage not covered by an agreed committed-volume arrangement, pricing is progressive: only pages falling within a particular tier are charged at that tier’s rate.

Cumulative pages during API Access PeriodRate
1–1,000 pages₹20/page
1,001–5,000 pages₹15/page
5,001–10,000 pages₹10/page
10,001 pages and above₹8/page

Standard pricing tiers apply to cumulative usage during the API Access Period and do not reset when additional pages are processed.

Committed Volume Pricing for Dharohar

In view of the processing volumes indicated by Dharohar and its charitable/public-service mandate, IIIT-H proposes the following discounted pricing against agreed volume commitments:

Usage scenario Approx. volume Earlier effective rate Earlier total Revised rate Revised total
Ongoing project 45,000 pages ₹9.11/page ₹4,10,000 ₹5.00/page ₹2,25,000
Regular workload (~1,500 pages/week) ~78,000 pages/year ₹8.64/page ₹6,74,000/year ₹4.00/page ₹3,12,000/year

Earlier effective rates and totals are calculated using the progressive pricing schedule above. All amounts are exclusive of applicable GST.

Selected committed-volume arrangement:

The revised rates apply only against the corresponding committed processing volume. The committed amount remains payable in accordance with Section 8 even if actual utilisation is lower. Unused committed pages are non-refundable and do not carry forward beyond the applicable agreed processing or commitment period. Additional committed volume may be agreed in writing at the applicable rate.

05 Quality Reporting and Credits

As an automated ML service, line-segmentation outputs may occasionally contain missed, spurious, merged, split, or otherwise incorrectly segmented lines.

Dharohar may optionally flag materially incorrect outputs. IIIT-H will verify such cases. Where a folio is verified by IIIT-H to have a materially unusable segmentation result, the processing charge for that folio will be credited.

Minor segmentation or polygon variations that do not materially impair downstream use will not ordinarily qualify for a credit.

06 Data Handling

Dharohar manuscript images, metadata and related information remain subject to Dharohar’s rights and applicable library/custodian restrictions.

Submitted manuscript images may be retained temporarily by IIIT-H for service logging, troubleshooting, verification of reported failures, and internal quality analysis. Manuscript content will be deleted no later than after processing, unless otherwise mutually agreed.

Operational metadata that does not contain manuscript content may be retained for usage accounting, security and service monitoring. Manuscript content will not be shared with third parties.

07 API Access and Intellectual Property

Each Party retains its Background IP as defined in the MoU. LekhyaAI models, source code, model weights, training code, methods and associated software remain IIIT-H Background IP.

Dharohar receives a non-exclusive, non-transferable right during the API Access Period to access the API for its institutional manuscript-processing activities. Dharohar may retain and use the line-segmentation outputs generated for its manuscripts.

Dharohar shall not reverse engineer the service, circumvent API access controls or usage metering, share credentials with unauthorized parties, or sublicense/resell the API as a service to third parties.

No source-code or model-weight transfer is implied.

08 Commercial and Payment Terms

For standard on-demand usage not covered by a committed-volume arrangement, charges will be based on the progressive pricing schedule in Section 4.

For an agreed committed-volume arrangement, the discounted rate is conditional on the corresponding volume commitment. Payment will be made over the agreed processing or commitment period as follows:

Payment pointShare of committed amount
At project / commitment commencement50%
At the midpoint of the agreed processing / commitment period25%
At completion of the agreed processing / commitment period25%

The payment schedule stages payment of the committed amount; it does not convert the arrangement into pay-per-use billing. Applicable GST will be charged additionally as per law.

Any change to the selected committed volume, validity period or negotiated pricing will be recorded through mutual written agreement.

09 Service Operation and Coordination

IIIT-H will use reasonable efforts to maintain the API as an operational service during the API Access Period. Temporary interruptions may occur for maintenance, infrastructure issues, upgrades, or circumstances beyond IIIT-H’s reasonable control.

IIIT-H Technical Point of Contact: Prof. Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla
Dharohar Technical Point of Contact:

Minor operational matters may be agreed through written communication. Material changes to scope, pricing, data handling, or the API Access Period will be documented through an amendment to this SoW.
